name: SubjectNet
purpose: Decides whether a motion part of a sentence is about the object being moved ("the drone should rise 4 metres") or about something else ("Mia turned to her brother"), so that the motion reader keeps only the right parts.

name: owNet
purpose: The net built from scratch in Unit 4: it reads a short expression such as (a⨁b)⨂c, token by token, and writes the distributed form in prefix order (⨁ ⨂ a c ⨂ b c).

name: tnParserNet
purpose: Parses a tensor-algebra expression: reads its tokens and writes its tree in prefix order, for the exact engine to check and use.

name: tnPolicyNet
purpose: Simplifies: given an expression, chooses which rewrite rule to apply and at which node, so that the exact engine can carry it out soundly.

name: tnValueNet
purpose: Evaluates: estimates three numbers about an expression (such as its dimension and its number of terms), checked against exact values from the symbolic engine.

name: WeaveNet
purpose: Learns the regular criss-cross weave of normal fabric, so that whatever it cannot redraw (holes, loose threads, runs, knots) shows up as the defect: the learnt counterpart of removing the weave with an FFT notch filter.
